page.overview:
Who is Eoin?

Eoin was the son of King Dagread and the king of Kaedwen after his father's death.

When he was still a young king, he was approached by Dowager Marchioness Cervia Herrada de Graffiacane and her lover, the powerful mage, Artamon of Asguth, with a petition to label all witchers as criminals and outlaw them. Despite being young, he still saw through this ploy as nothing more than two parents distraught and clinging to rumors about their son's killer. He thus refused it on account of them having no proof who actually killed their son, and likewise no collective responsibility could be applied, and the fact witchers were very much needed to help out settlers.

A few years later, Kaer Morhen was attacked in by a vigilante mob, who'd been rallied by The Description of a Monstrum or a Witcher. As having lawless groups running around wasn't good for keeping things peaceful in the kingdom, this annoyed both Eoin and other margraves. In turn, he had a few of the mob members killed to set an example, though none killed were any of the real ringleaders.
